lines: Invoked by me god on altar and established; worshipped praised thus having rejoiced god should dismiss.
l4.sanskrit_cite: āvāhito mayā devaḥ sthaṇḍile ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ pūjitaḥ stuta ityevaṃ hṛṣṭvā devaṃ visarjayet
